parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by checking for the 'values' attribute and ensuring the value is not an instance of np.ndarray before converting it to an object array. This should prevent unintended type coercion.

issues.description: The code could be slightly more readable by adding a comment explaining the purpose of the 'if hasattr(value, 'values') and not isinstance(value, np.ndarray):' condition.
